size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the forgot-password controller, which the prompt points at by naming POST /v1/auth/forgot-password and the misaddressed email.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/forgot-password returns 204, but the reset email is addressed to a long token-like string instead of the user, and the link inside it contains the user's email address where the token should be.

root_cause.detail: forgotPassword calls sendResetPasswordEmail(resetPasswordToken, req.body.email) with the arguments swapped; the signature is (to, token).

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/forgot-password > should return 204 and send reset password email to the user
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 204 and send reset password email to the user'
